title: Increasing Minority Participation in Clinical Trials
brief_summary: This study will measure the effects of an office-based, clinical trial education video on clinical trial knowledge and enrollment in clinical trials, in a clinical sample with no previous history of clinical trial participation. This study will also determine the feasibility of implementing an office-based video educational program.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Participants will be patients of Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center (VICC) with a diagnosis of cancer Participants will have no previous history of clinical trial research participation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous history of clinical trial research participation
